draft_en.subject: Two SKUs for the IC Intracom installer channel - 8-PoE L2+ and gigabit MC
draft_en.body:
Hi Hristo,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 21 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the installer channel, two neutral-brand items from small lots, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); industrial mini Gigabit media converter with SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5.

One question: is product sourcing for IC Intracom Bulgaria local, or via the Intellinet team in Germany?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
